import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
s='[Br][C][=C][C][=C][C][Branch1][#C][C][=C][C][=C][C][=C][C][=C][C][Ring1][=Branch1][=C][Ring1][#Branch2][=C][C][=C][C][=C][C][Ring1][=Branch1][=C][Branch1][#C][C][=C][C][=C][C][=C][C][=C][C][Ring1][=Branch1][=C][Ring1][#Branch2][C][Ring2][Ring1][=C][=C][Ring2][Ring2][C]'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(sf.decoder(s))
rw=Chem.RWMol(m)
br=next(a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Br')
carbon=rw.GetAtomWithIdx(br).GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
rw.RemoveAtom(br)
m=rw.GetMol()
pin=Chem.MolFromSmiles('B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1')
combo=Chem.CombineMols(m,pin)
rw=Chem.RWMol(combo)
boron=next(a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='B')
# product aromatic attachment center converted from brominated alkene/aromatic carbon
rw.AddBond(carbon,boron,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
prod=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(prod)
print('product_smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(prod,canonical=True))
print('formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(prod))
print('bromine_atoms',sum(a.GetSymbol()=='Br' for a in prod.GetAtoms()),'boron_atoms',sum(a.GetSymbol()=='B' for a in prod.GetAtoms()))
